title: Personal Statement
subtitle: Who I am and what I do
body:
I'm a Research Fellow (postdoctoral researcher) at the University of Rome Tor Vergata. Before that I completed my Ph.D. in AI in Education at Maynooth University (2022–2026), where I also lectured from 2022 to 2026.
I've taught computer science for over ten years, at Maynooth University, Dublin City University, Fuzhou University and on a summer school for Texas Tech students. I also hold a Level 9 certificate in Speech & Drama, which helps me explain complex ideas clearly. I also worked as a UI/UX engineer at SAP (2021–2022).

title: Teaching Statement
subtitle: How I teach
body:
I believe anyone can become great at anything with the right teacher, and that's what I try to be.
- Learn by building: students work on real projects, not just exercises. On the Texas Tech summer school, my class went from beginner programmers to designing their own version of the game Asteroids, and I ran mock interviews to prepare them for jobs.
- Learn together: collaboration, peer feedback and shared work are built into my modules.
- Everyone takes part: I aim for an inclusive classroom where students feel able to ask and try.
- Use technology with care: I bring in tools like generative AI where they help learning, and talk openly with students about their limits.

title: Joe Timoney
subtitle: Head of Maynooth International Engineering College, Maynooth University
body:
“Mark is very clever and capable. He is a great teacher and really liked by his classes. He is a motivated researcher and is working hard to contribute to his field.”
Joe managed Mark directly (September 2022).

title: Behnam Faghih
subtitle: Assistant Professor / Lecturer in Computer Science, Maynooth University
body:
“He was always prepared and knowledgeable to answer undergraduate students' questions reasonably. Moreover, when the other demonstrators could not find the answer to the questions, they were usually asking for Mark's help, and he supported his colleagues pleasantly. Several times that I couldn't attend the labs, Mark was the head, managing everything very well.”
“I saw that Mark's students were very excited about his classes.”
Behnam worked with Mark as a fellow lab demonstrator and summer school lecturer (September 2022).
